description: Editorial workflow + immutable audit log (§4.5/§4.6) — VNG local Strapi plugin.

strapi.name: editorial
strapi.description: Content workflow, RBAC-gated transitions and an immutable audit log.

_comment_exports: `./strapi-server` MUST point at ./strapi-server.js — a hand-written CommonJS
bridge in this directory (see that file for the full reasoning). Strapi joins
this target onto path.resolve(dirs.app.root, resolve), and the app root is the
PROJECT root, whose src/ tree is TypeScript. A .ts target makes the entrypoint
path not-exist, and Strapi's loader skips a missing entrypoint SILENTLY — the
plugin never loads and nothing at all is logged.
`./strapi-admin` stays on the .ts: it is consumed by the Vite admin build,
which reads TypeScript source. apps/cms/tsconfig.json deliberately EXCLUDES
src/plugins/*/admin and src/plugins/*/strapi-admin.ts from the server compile,
so there is no .js to point at — by design.
